facts.value: Mooby says its cinemas support reduced-mobility access and asks wheelchair users to purchase at the cinema box office.
facts.scope: Operator-wide policy; room routes require venue-specific evidence.

facts.value: Mobile tickets are accepted. Published policy allows no ticket changes or refunds.
Cinemas open 15 minutes before the first screening.
info@moobycinemas.com; booking-process support chat Monday–Friday 15:00–20:00, Saturday/Sunday 12:00–20:00.
Private screenings and event hire are offered through the operator’s venue-hire enquiry form.
Club Phenomena is for people over 16. The personal virtual card permits one discounted ticket per member per eligible session; ID may be checked. Fee and expiry vary by enrolment offer.
L5 Sant Pau / Dos de Maig is the metro stop listed by the operator’s legacy website.
Unnumbered seating. A group using one QR must enter together; late admission may be refused.
Published terms prohibit outside food/drink, bicycles, scooters and bulky objects.
facts.scope: Operator’s stated conditions; no assessment of enforceability.

facts.value: Online and app purchases carry an additional non-refundable service charge; its amount is not stated in the terms. Official channels also include the box office and cinema kiosks.
Published terms reject ordinary changes/refunds. If the cinema cancels for technical or force-majeure reasons, it allows a refund request within 14 days.
The purchase terms mention under-12 and over-65 discounts and Club tickets, with official photo ID required. Discount amounts are not specified.
Parking is available in the same building; tariff and cinema validation were not verified.
Nearby FGC El Putxet is on L7. FGC lists lifts and accessibility facilities at that station.
facts.scope: Station facilities do not establish a step-free route all the way to an auditorium.

facts.value: Electric scooters and unicycles are prohibited in the cinema.
The operator lists parking within the cinema complex; tariff and validation remain unverified.
Nearby Fontana is on metro L3.
facts.scope: Walking time and a step-free journey have not been measured.

facts.value: Apropa Cultura lists an accessible entrance, adapted lifts, accessible toilets and parking, wheelchair spaces, guide-dog access and easy-read information.
facts.scope: Venue listing; no per-room wheelchair inventory or hearing-system specification.

facts.value: Cine Bosque, S.L. (NIF B08335549) is named as applicant for the thermal-energy project at Rambla de Prat 16.
facts.scope: Documented venue-associated company, not proof of property ownership or the current lease.

facts.value: Published aerothermal project: 725.6 kW; report lists Midea MV8i-560WV2RN1E(PRO), MV8i-450WV2RN1E(PRO) and CIAT VECTIOS IPJ 0240CTR, 0180CTR and 0160CTR equipment.
facts.scope: Heating/cooling project, not projection equipment. Commissioning and final installed configuration are not established.

facts.value: The Catalan Film Academy marked Bosque as an operating centenary cinema with a plaque on 27 October 2020.
IN-EDIT lists Universitat (L1/L2) and Catalunya (L1/L3); buses 52, 54, H12, V13, 59, 63, 67 and 68 at Gran Via/Balmes or Plaça Universitat.
facts.scope: Organizer’s directions, not a live timetable.

facts.value: Rooms 1–4 have lift access, street-level accessible toilets and two wheelchair positions per room, according to IN-EDIT.
Sala 5 uses a platform stairlift with a 300 kg limit. Wheelchair positions are in the aisle; accessible toilets are in rooms 1–4 opposite Sala 5.
Unlimited has a three-month minimum. VIP seats are included where available; annual subscriptions do not receive a refund on cancellation.
facts.scope: Formats and 3D glasses may add charges.

facts.value: Published policy rejects ordinary changes/cancellations, with exceptions for cinema-caused technical failure or cancellation.
Registered myCinesa users can change selected seats in the app; this is separate from changing or cancelling a screening.
Wheelchair positions are marked in online booking maps. Staff can assist with in-person booking and special assistance.
facts.scope: Chain policy; detailed accessible routes and hearing equipment remain separate questions.

facts.value: The shopping centre lists El Maresme | Fòrum on L4.
Three free parking hours per day, plus one extra hour with the centre app or a cinema ticket presented at the manual cashier on P1 before payment.
The centre lists 5,000 parking spaces across five underground levels; 54 are designated accessible spaces.
Winter parking: Monday–Thursday 08:30–01:00; Friday/Saturday/holiday eves 08:30–03:00; Sunday and closed shopping holidays 11:00–01:00.
facts.scope: Winter schedule, 1 October–31 May; shopping and cinema opening hours differ.

facts.value: Centre entrances: Calle de Barcelona 2 and Avenida Josep Tarradellas s/n. Published public transport: Rambla Just Oliveras metro, Hospitalet de Llobregat commuter rail, Sant Josep FGC, buses L12/LH2.
Three hours of free parking are advertised while watching a film at Cinesa. The page does not explain the validation procedure.
Parking opens Monday–Thursday/Sunday 06:00–01:00 and Friday/Saturday/holiday eves 06:00–03:30.
Parking enquiries: parking@centrolafarga.com; centre management: +34 933 380 737.
facts.scope: Shopping centre, not cinema box office.

facts.scope: Chain platform legal entity; current venue leaseholder and building title are not established.

facts.value: Yelmo’s terms describe possible Senior (over 60), youth/student (13–30), child (3–13) and disability discounts. Disability eligibility is 33% or more and may include one companion. Categories and amounts are not guaranteed for every cinema/session.
Under-3s may enter without a ticket if they occupy no seat, except Sala Junior, where everyone needs a ticket.
Seat selection is part of purchase; the published conditions allow no changes or refunds after confirmation. Prices include VAT and may vary by date, time and format.
The terms mention MovieYELMO, with at most two tickets per web transaction and film/promotion exclusions. No current membership tariff was established.
The centre lists L1 Sant Andreu/Torras i Bages and L9/L10 Bon Pastor. Underground parking entrances are on Potosí and São Paulo; exterior parking is reached from República Dominicana.
facts.scope: The L9/L10 directions refer to the northern branches; no walking time is asserted.

facts.value: 4,800 spaces across two underground levels and an exterior car park; 2.2 m height limit. First three hours free; Westfield Club adds one hour. A Carrefour purchase over EUR 20 can alternatively add one hour; benefits cannot be combined.
Parking: Monday–Thursday/Sunday 08:30–01:30; Friday/Saturday 08:30–03:30.
The centre lists accessible circulation/parking and wheelchair rental, plus electric charging and bicycle/motorcycle parking.
facts.scope: Shopping-centre facilities; not a room-by-room cinema accessibility audit.

facts.value: Reduced tickets: children through age 12 and disabled customers every day; age 65+, youth/student card holders Monday–Thursday excluding holidays/eves. Proof required. Under-3s enter free without occupying a seat; VIP/recliner discounts excluded on weekends/holidays.
Operator lists daily cinema hours 10:45–01:00 and box-office hours 10:30–23:00.
info.espana@kinepolis.com is the operator’s published customer contact.
Operator lists Cornellà Riera FGC, Cornellà Centre metro L5, and T1/T2 tram at Cornellà Centre or Les Aigües.
facts.scope: Operator directions; older bus-route numbers were not propagated.

facts.value: The centre advertises 2,800 free underground spaces over two levels, with PMR, family and larger/smaller bays. Eight EV charging points are paid; entrances are on Carrer Progrés and Carretera del Mig.

The operator’s current Spanish room table marks all 28 salas as accessible and lists wheelchair positions for each room. These positions are recorded separately from fixed seats in the room catalogue.
facts.scope: Operator claim, not an independent route or hearing-equipment audit.

facts.value: Published rules conflict: the online-refund FAQ gives a request deadline 30 minutes after the start; the wrong-cinema FAQ says 30 minutes before; general conditions describe fixed-session tickets as non-refundable. Confirm the applicable case with customer support.
A 10 July 2013 report records the inauguration of ten additional rooms, expanding Full HD at Splau from 18 to 28; reported investment EUR 4 million.

conflicts.description: Google listing says no accessible seating, but the operator lists wheelchair positions in all 28 rooms. Neither statement is silently discarded; use the room table for published counts and confirm the required route.
Different Kinépolis FAQs give before/after-start refund deadlines; general terms are more restrictive. Scenarios and source statements are kept separate.
Both language versions say 0.05 cents per minute. This may be a unit error; no EUR-per-minute number is inferred.
Fresh same-day operator HTML says EUR 7; an older indexed excerpt says EUR 6.90. The captured HTML is used, dated 2026-11-19.
The EUR 10 English heading names Friday, Saturday and holidays, but not Sunday. The separate EUR 13 Sunday-inclusive heading applies to Gran Sarrià only and is not borrowed.
